title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། དབུ་མ། ལ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 105)
shelf_note: Volume 105 (letter La) of the Derge Tengyur Madhyamaka section, containing canonical Indian Madhyamaka treatises and commentaries.

tr_errors_A.problem: Misinterprets a grammatical gloss explaining the particle 'yang' ('and/also') as 'slar' ('further/again') as a rhetorical statement about emphasizing meaning

tr_errors_A.english: The origin of suffering is the world
tr_errors_A.problem: Conflates the first two items of a list (duhkha, samudaya, loka) into 'the origin of suffering' and misinterprets the verse syntax as an equational clause
Translates an incomplete orphan syllable at the leaf boundary ('nye') literally as the independent word 'near'

pages.prefer_reason: Version B correctly interprets the particle commentary, accurately parses the cited verse, and cleanly handles the leaf boundary fragments.

book_verdict: Clear woodblock leaf from the Derge Tengyur with a completely accurate transcription; Translation B provides an exceptionally faithful and technically precise rendering of the Madhyamaka commentary.
